Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment is a classic AP-MS (Affinity Purification Mass Spectrometry) to identify the DIAPH3 interactome. While the paper discusses tubulin acetylation extensively via immunoblotting and immunofluorescence, the mass spectrometry portion was used for interactome identification (AP-MS) and not for acetylome enrichment. Therefore, mod_ap_ms is the correct modifier, not mod_acetyl.
